subject: Vendor onboarding: PO visibility, invoice ack semantics, and SMTP fallback
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenridge-logistics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@greenridge-logistics.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding questions — PO visibility & invoice path

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the onboarding packet. A couple of questions from our side as we prepare to activate Redwood as a supplier: 

1) PO visibility: Our AP system requires the PO number to be present in both the email subject and the invoice body for automated matching. Does Redwood surface the PO at the subject level when raising invoices, or should we rely on a subject token approach?

2) Invoice channel: We prefer to use your portal but need an email fallback for a subset of logistics partners that cannot connect to SFTP. If we send invoices to an email fallback, what acknowledgement should we expect (email auto-reply vs. portal ack)?

3) Template questions: I attached the sample invoice layout we use internally (greenridge_sample_invoice_template.csv). Can you confirm minimal required columns (we have line-level item, PO, entity, tax fields)?

We are trying to group vendors by capability; if portal-only vendors are easiest to onboard, we can move them first and keep the email fallback for the legacy partners.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Procurement Manager
Greenridge Logistics
Attachments: greenridge_sample_invoice_template.csv (csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenridge-logistics.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding questions — PO visibility & invoice path

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the template. Quick answers and a proposed plan below.

1) PO visibility: We can support both approaches. Recommended default is using a subject token: "PO=12345" in the subject line. That is how our SMTP/portal handoffs reliably map to the PO in the ledger. If you require the PO in the invoice body for your parser, include it in line 1 of the invoice body as well.

2) Invoice channel & acknowledgements:
- Portal: immediate portal ack (status=Received) and daily ingestion report.
- Email fallback: we support SMTP ingestion to invoices@redwoodinference.com. Email receipts trigger an automated acknowledgement email with a subject token and ingestion id (e.g., RID-20270419-4582). Note: email ingestion has slightly longer processing SLA (up to 24 hours) and higher variance for PDFs that need OCR.

3) Minimal required columns: PO, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Line Description, Qty, Unit Price, Net Amount, Entity Code (if multi-entity), and Currency. Tax columns are optional but preferred. If you can supply the CSV mapping you sent, our onboarding form will validate and flag missing fields.

Proposed rollout: Phase 1 — portal-first onboarding for vendors who can SSO or upload CSV. Phase 2 — enable SMTP fallback for legacy partners, limited to one-day batched processing and manual exception handling for OCR failures. We'll provide a subject convention and sample ack.

I attached our vendor onboarding form (greenridge_onboarding_form_v3.pdf) — please complete the form and return. I'll loop in Vanessa (billing ops) and Jordan (vendor activation) to coordinate timelines.

Next steps:
- Maya: complete onboarding form and confirm whether you need PO in subject + body or subject-only.
- Karthik/Vanessa/Jordan: prepare portal access and SMTP fallback rules.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: greenridge_onboarding_form_v3.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenridge-logistics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding questions — PO visibility & invoice path

Hi Maya,

Couple practical notes from billing ops as you fill the form: 
- If you choose subject-token routing we ask that subjects follow this exact prefix: "RDW_PO=XXXXXX | CompanyName | Invoice#" so our parser picks the token reliably.
- For CSV feeds via portal, please include a header row with the exact column names: po_number, invoice_number, invoice_date, line_description, qty, unit_price, net_amount, entity_code, currency. We will validate these on upload and provide a mapping file if names differ.
- For the email fallback: PDFs are accepted but attachments must be < 15MB. Large zipped batches should use SFTP (we can provision).

Operational SLAs: portal uploads = same-day ingest (if before 5pm PT). SMTP fallback = processed within 24 hours, exceptions handled next business day. If you need a faster SLA for a small set of partners we can discuss a dedicated intake path.

I'll hold a 30-min activation window next Wednesday 9am PT for portal enrollment if that works for your team — Karthik/Jordan will join.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenridge-logistics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks Karthik and Vanessa — this is helpful. A couple quick confirmations: 
- Greenridge will adopt the portal-first approach for 80% of our vendor base. For ~20% legacy carriers we'll enable the SMTP path.
- We'll follow your subject token prefix exactly (RDW_PO=). We'll also include PO on line 1 of the invoice body for our internal parser.
- I'll complete and return greenridge_onboarding_form_v3.pdf by end of day tomorrow.

Can you add the activation window invite for next Wed 9am PT to my calendar? My team (including our AP analyst, Ravi Kumar) will join.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this should speed up our go-live.

Maya
Procurement Manager
Greenridge Logistics
